owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider page-quality programme

baseline.source: Independent exact-live review and public/source comparison after batch14. Complete 23-criterion scores unavailable for all three pages.
baseline.capelSound: Published text claimed campsite booking by ballot a year ahead; current operator states first come, first served and a waitlist. The page dated the Rosebud West rename 2017, while the Victoria Government Gazette records 2016. Fallback image depicted a generic pier/headland but alt described tents behind dunes; its rights record was temporary.
baseline.boneo: Lede put Peninsula Hot Springs, Alba and RACV Cape Schanck Resort in Boneo; operator addresses place them in Fingal and Cape Schanck.
baseline.rye: Intro implied Rye was the last town before Sorrento and Portsea, omitting Blairgowrie. Fallback alt described a dusk pier while source image showed a daytime bay beach. The public CMS hero override has generic alt and no visible item-level source/credit.

hypothesis: Correcting visitor-critical geography and camping instructions and using an attributable local image will make these linked guides more trustworthy and Capel Sound easier to use.

Correct Boneo and Rye place descriptions and Rye fallback alt; prevent all CMS override photos from inheriting the fallback image's visible description. Do not assert rights for the existing Rye/Boneo public CMS hero overrides.
